evidence.claim: El-Sisi stressed the importance of dialogue and diplomatic solutions and affirmed Egypt's support for settling the Ukraine crisis politically through discussions and negotiations.
evidence.title: President El-Sisi Speaks with Ukraine's President Zelensky
evidence.publisher: Presidency of the Arab Republic of Egypt
evidence.excerpt: El-Sisi stressed the importance of dialogue and diplomatic solutions and affirmed Egypt's support for settling the Ukraine crisis politically through discussions and negotiations.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct 2022 presidential statement published by the Egyptian presidency.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct ruler statement and public diplomacy; not evidence of operational military control.
contrary_evidence: This is a diplomatic posture statement, not evidence that Egypt shaped the Ukraine war outcome.

evidence.claim: Israel and Palestinian militants agreed to observe a Gaza truce as proposed by Cairo, with an Egyptian security source saying Israel had accepted the offer and a Palestinian source saying the ceasefire would take effect that evening.
evidence.title: Israel, Palestinians agree truce from Sunday evening - sources
evidence.excerpt: Israel and Palestinian militants agreed to observe a Gaza truce as proposed by Cairo, with an Egyptian security source saying Israel had accepted the offer and a Palestinian source saying the ceasefire would take effect that evening.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters wire reporting is strong independent confirmation, though this is a syndicated Euronews page.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Supports attribution to Egypt's mediation role under Sisi's leadership, but not a private command decision.
contrary_evidence: The same escalation still caused civilian deaths and damage before the truce.
A temporary truce is not the same as a durable settlement.

evidence.claim: The U.N. special coordinator said Egypt's efforts helped prevent the outbreak of a full-scale war in Gaza and allowed humanitarian relief into the Strip.
evidence.title: Ceasefire Between Israel, Palestinian Militants 'Fragile', Middle East Coordinator Tells Security Council, Urging All Parties to Uphold Truce, Safeguard Past Gains
evidence.excerpt: The U.N. special coordinator said Egypt's efforts helped prevent the outbreak of a full-scale war in Gaza and allowed humanitarian relief into the Strip.
evidence.source_locator: meeting coverage paragraph containing 'Together these efforts helped prevent the outbreak of a full-scale war'
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official U.N. meeting record with contemporaneous attribution of Egypt's role.
evidence.ruler_attribution: External confirmation of Egypt's role; not a finding about internal Egyptian deliberations.
contrary_evidence: The ceasefire was fragile and did not resolve the underlying conflict.
This confirms mediation, not long-term conflict resolution.

evidence.claim: Sisi hosted a summit with the UAE and Israel, and Egypt said the talks covered energy markets, food security, and other regional and international issues.
evidence.title: Egypt, UAE, Israel hold summit talks in Red Sea resort
evidence.excerpt: Sisi hosted a summit with the UAE and Israel, and Egypt said the talks covered energy markets, food security, and other regional and international issues.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters wire reporting is strong independent evidence of the meeting and its agenda.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Sisi as host and participant in regional diplomacy.
contrary_evidence: A summit is not by itself a peace agreement or a durable settlement.
The report is broad on content and does not show concrete conflict resolution.

evidence.claim: El-Sisi reaffirmed support for security and stability in Iraq, rejected non-aggression and non-interference violations, and framed regional cooperation around sovereignty and good-neighborliness under the U.N. Charter.
evidence.title: President El-Sisi's Speech at the "Baghdad Conference for Cooperation and Partnership"
evidence.publisher: Presidency of the Arab Republic of Egypt
evidence.excerpt: El-Sisi reaffirmed support for security and stability in Iraq, rejected non-aggression and non-interference violations, and framed regional cooperation around sovereignty and good-neighborliness under the U.N. Charter.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct 2022 presidential speech with explicit references to non-aggression and sovereignty.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct ruler statement expressing Egypt's security doctrine in regional affairs.
contrary_evidence: This is a regional norms speech, not evidence of a specific conflict settlement outcome.
The speech is aspirational and broad.

evidence.claim: Egypt and Greece rejected a preliminary Turkey-Libya energy exploration agreement in disputed eastern Mediterranean areas.
evidence.title: مصر واليونان ترفضان اتفاقا مبدئيا بين تركيا وليبيا للتنقيب عن الطاقة
evidence.excerpt: Egypt and Greece rejected a preliminary Turkey-Libya energy exploration agreement in disputed eastern Mediterranean areas.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters wire reporting gives independent confirmation of Egypt's legal-diplomatic response.
evidence.ruler_attribution: State position under Sisi, expressed as diplomatic/legal opposition rather than force.
contrary_evidence: Rejection of an agreement is not the same as a settlement.

unresolved_gaps: No direct evidence of Sisi personally making a 2022 nuclear-safety, command-and-control, or crisis-escalation choice.
Concrete durable-conflict outcomes are thin beyond mediation and de-escalatory posture.
Exact chains of command and the effectiveness of pardon/reform mechanisms remain opaque.
There was no 2022 election, so contestability and transfer-rule evidence remains mostly structural rather than event-based.
Household-level distribution and implementation depth of the reform package are still thin.
Independent 2022 household outcome data are still thin, especially on whether transfers and pensions offset inflation.
There is no direct 2022 asset declaration, audit trail, procurement finding, or court judgment tying Sisi or close family to specific private gain from office.
Direct truthfulness/correction evidence from Sisi's own statements is still thin.
Direct evidence of Sisi's personal steering of tactical adjustments and durable outcome attribution remains limited.
